title: chrysanthemum lavandulifolium var. acutum
intro: Chrysanthemum lavandulifolium var. acutum, commonly known as Korean chrysanthemum, is a variety of flowering plant in the daisy family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Korean chrysanthemum include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents in Korean chrysanthemum may also include sesquiterpenes, coumarins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
